title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Lease-End Accounting: Figuring the Early Termination Charge
content:
# Lease-End Accounting Note — The Early Termination Charge, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Calculation.** On a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the early termination charge starts from the termination fee, which is the closed-end early termination fee for the unit's program tier. The early termination charge is the termination fee, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Order of figuring.** The charge is put together in one fixed order: a schedule that replaces a standard figure applies first; any multiplier then applies to the charge so far; any credit is then subtracted, never taking the charge below zero; any addition comes last; and the charge is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## The calculation in parts

| Quantity | Source | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Termination fee | the closed-end early termination fee of the unit's program tier | taken as the starting figure |
| Early termination charge | the termination fee | rounded to the nearest cent, once, at the end |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A closed-end unit in a hypothetical program tier whose closed-end early termination fee is 720. The termination fee is 720; the early termination charge is 720.00.

## Points of judgement

- **Which tier's fee?** The closed-end early termination fee of the program tier the unit's schedule was written in.
- **When is rounding applied?** Once, at the end of the figuring, to the nearest cent.
- **Can the charge be negative?** No. A credit subtracted never takes the charge below zero.
